entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr grinned."
entries.dialogueText: Petr grinned.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Oh, you'd be surprised.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, you'd be surprised."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I walked him out, then got busy pac..."
entries.dialogueText: I walked him out, then got busy packing. My head was buzzing with excitement.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Exactly.""
entries.dialogueText: "Exactly."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't know if I can make it to t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know if I can make it to the end of the term."
entries.menuText: "I don't know if I can make it to the end of my term."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't think I can win this elect..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't think I can win this election."
entries.menuText: "I don't think I can win this election."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Right away, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Right away, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I can't wait till I can leave this..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't wait till I can leave this all behind."
entries.menuText: "I can't wait till I can leave this all behind."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was time for a fresh start. I ho..."
entries.dialogueText: It was time for a fresh start. I hoped Petr would understand.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I went up to my office and spun the..."
entries.dialogueText: I went up to my office and spun the globe on my desk.
entries.menuText: Flee the country.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I decided to cover up my tracks. Th..."
entries.dialogueText: I decided to cover up my tracks. There were some documents that needed to be incinerated.
entries.menuText: Leave after covering up your tracks.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't think I want another term.""
entries.dialogueText: "I don't think I want another term."
entries.menuText: "I don't think I want another term."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The usual crowd of protesters was w..."
entries.dialogueText: The usual crowd of protesters was waiting for me outside the gates of the complex.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I can't wait for my next term.""
entries.dialogueText: "I can't wait for my next term."
entries.menuText: "I can't wait for my next term."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I didn't know if it was my imaginat..."
entries.dialogueText: I didn't know if it was my imagination, but there seemed to be more guards outside my complex than usual.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Talk to me, Anton. I know you've g..."
entries.dialogueText: "Talk to me, Anton. I know you've got something on your mind."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thanks. If you don't mind, Petr, I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks. If you don't mind, Petr, I'd rather be alone tonight after all. I want to think about my next steps."
entries.menuText: "Thanks. If you don't mind, Petr, I'd rather be alone tonight after all. I want to think about my next steps."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The guards formed a cordon to let P..."
entries.dialogueText: The guards formed a cordon to let Petr and me through.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was time for a fresh start. I ho..."
entries.dialogueText: It was time for a fresh start. I hoped Petr would understand.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That Anton Rayne was a liar.""
entries.dialogueText: "That Anton Rayne was a liar."
entries.menuText: "That Anton Rayne was a liar."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Anton? Something on your mind?""
entries.dialogueText: "Anton? Something on your mind?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr leaned over and switched off t..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr leaned over and switched off the TV. He looked at me with serious eyes.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Now you listen here.""
entries.dialogueText: "Now you listen here."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Come on, Anton. Really?""
entries.dialogueText: "Come on, Anton. Really?"

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "We rushed past the guards to my doo..."
entries.dialogueText: We rushed past the guards to my door.
entries.menuText: Don't look at them and go to your door.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I regarded them with suspicion as I..."
entries.dialogueText: I regarded them with suspicion as I passed. With the military against me, could they be trusted?
entries.menuText: Give the guards a suspicious look.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I started packing my suitcase. I wa..."
entries.dialogueText: I started packing my suitcase. I wasn't going to stay in Sordland a second longer.
entries.menuText: Leave now.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We hurried past them and went insid..."
entries.dialogueText: We hurried past them and went inside. I locked the front door behind me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Once we were inside, I locked the f..."
entries.dialogueText: Once we were inside, I locked the front door behind me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr smiled."
entries.dialogueText: Petr smiled.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I could go to Kyrute. It was the on..."
entries.dialogueText: I could go to Kyrute. It was the one completely neutral country I knew of, and a little house in the mountains wouldn't cost me much.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I hoped Petr wouldn't be too mad at..."
entries.dialogueText: I hoped Petr wouldn't be too mad at me for letting him down.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "If only for Petr's sake."
entries.dialogueText: If only for Petr's sake.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I only had a few months left as Pre..."
entries.dialogueText: I only had a few months left as President of Sordland. I had to make them count.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A slow smile spread across Petr's f..."
entries.dialogueText: A slow smile spread across Petr's face.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'd make dinner, but the chef has..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd make dinner, but the chef has the night off and I don't have any food in the fridge."
entries.menuText: "I'd make dinner, but the chef has the night off and I don't have any food in the fridge."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Damn right you will.""
entries.dialogueText: "Damn right you will."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""See? The football team still think..."
entries.dialogueText: "See? The football team still thinks you're great."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sorry about the mess in here.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry about the mess in here."
entries.menuText: "Sorry about the mess in here."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""See? You've still got a few fans i..."
entries.dialogueText: "See? You've still got a few fans in Sordland."
entries.menuText: "See? You've still got a few fans in Sordland."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I can't even watch a goddamn footb..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't even watch a goddamn football game anymore!"
entries.menuText: "I can't even watch a goddamn football game anymore!"

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I gritted my teeth. I had come this..."
entries.dialogueText: I gritted my teeth. I had come this far. I would finish what I had started.
entries.menuText: Decide to continue.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I went up to my office and began dr..."
entries.dialogueText: I went up to my office and began drafting a speech announcing my retirement from politics.
entries.menuText: Draft a speech announcing your retirement from politics.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I went upstairs to my office and st..."
entries.dialogueText: I went upstairs to my office and started working again.
entries.menuText: Start planning for the end of your presidency.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't think we have a choice.""
entries.dialogueText: "I don't think we have a choice."
entries.menuText: "I don't think we have a choice."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes."
entries.menuText: "Yes."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Petr, want a beer?""
entries.dialogueText: "Petr, want a beer?"
entries.menuText: "Petr, want a beer?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Now that's the Anton Rayne I know..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now that's the Anton Rayne I know and love."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I lost Serge.""
entries.dialogueText: "I lost Serge."
entries.menuText: "I lost Serge."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I lost my wife, Petr.""
entries.dialogueText: "I lost my wife, Petr."
entries.menuText: "I lost my wife, Petr."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Whoa. Whoa! We're really doing thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whoa. Whoa! We're really doing this?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Maybe this would be my year after a..."
entries.dialogueText: Maybe this would be my year after all.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Why can't they just stick to kicki..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why can't they just stick to kicking the ball around? Why bring politics into it?"
entries.menuText: "Why can't they just stick to kicking the ball around? Why bring politics into it?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Ha. You should see my place.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ha. You should see my place."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After showing Petr to the door, I s..."
entries.dialogueText: After showing Petr to the door, I sat and thought for a while longer. His confidence in me was touching. But was it enough?

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""And you're coming with me.""
entries.dialogueText: "And you're coming with me."
entries.menuText: "And you're coming with me."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I won't ask you to come with me. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won't ask you to come with me. I know you've got your life here."
entries.menuText: "I won't ask you to come with me. I know you've got your life here."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sorry. I suddenly lost my interest..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry. I suddenly lost my interest in football."
entries.menuText: "Sorry. I suddenly lost my interest in football."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr glanced around the house. With..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr glanced around the house. With Monica and the children's belongings gone and my work documents spread everywhere, it barely resembled a home.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My presidency was coming to an end...."
entries.dialogueText: My presidency was coming to an end. But for this evening, at least, it didn't matter.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I walked Petr to the door, then wen..."
entries.dialogueText: I walked Petr to the door, then went upstairs. I still had some work to do.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Look at us. A couple of swinging b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look at us. A couple of swinging bachelors, just like in the old days."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""And I'll be right there with you.""
entries.dialogueText: "And I'll be right there with you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "FC Anrica was playing marvellously...."
entries.dialogueText: FC Anrica was playing marvellously. But as the game went on, I found my attention waning.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I turned the TV back on. FC Anrica..."
entries.dialogueText: I turned the TV back on. FC Anrica had already scored a goal.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Good luck, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good luck, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I can get along just fine without..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can get along just fine without her."
entries.menuText: "I can get along just fine without her."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Too good for me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Too good for me."
entries.menuText: "Too good for me."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""The Anton Rayne I met in universit..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Anton Rayne I met in university would never have sat around feeling sorry for himself like this."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm going to get my wife and kids..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm going to get my wife and kids back."
entries.menuText: "I'm going to get my wife and kids back."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I turned the TV back on. FC Anrica..."
entries.dialogueText: I turned the TV back on. FC Anrica had already scored a goal.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Good luck, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good luck, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I cracked open two beers and we rai..."
entries.dialogueText: I cracked open two beers and we raised the bottles in a brief toast.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""He was strong. Brave. Full of hope.""
entries.dialogueText: "He was strong. Brave. Full of hope."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The captain stood up and explained..."
entries.dialogueText: The captain stood up and explained that the President of Sordland had a substantial stake in the team. In protest of my despicable actions, he and his teammates would not be playing tonight.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Yeah, sure.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yeah, sure."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I thought you'd never ask.""
entries.dialogueText: "I thought you'd never ask."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Nothing would make me happier.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing would make me happier."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm going to crush *all* my enemie..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm going to crush *all* my enemies."
entries.menuText: "I'm going to crush *all* my enemies."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I picked up the nearest paperweight..."
entries.dialogueText: I picked up the nearest paperweight and threw it at the screen. Broken glass flew everywhere.
entries.menuText: Throw a heavy paperweight at the TV.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's true. I was strong. And I sti..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's true. I was strong. And I still am."
entries.menuText: "It's true. I was strong. And I still am."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Don't you worry. You'll find anoth..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't you worry. You'll find another woman deserving of the great Anton Rayne."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Now that I'd said it, it seemed lik..."
entries.dialogueText: Now that I'd said it, it seemed like the most obvious solution in the world. The gears in my head started spinning.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That Anton Rayne was a naive idiot.""
entries.dialogueText: "That Anton Rayne was a naive idiot."
entries.menuText: "That Anton Rayne was a naive idiot."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I thought you'd never ask.""
entries.dialogueText: "I thought you'd never ask."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Nothing would make me happier.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing would make me happier."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Yeah, sure.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yeah, sure."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thanks. Let's finish the game.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks. Let's finish the game."
entries.menuText: "Thanks, that means a lot. Let's finish the game."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thanks, that means a lot. Sorry I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks, that means a lot. Sorry I broke the TV, but you can still stay for a drink or two."
entries.menuText: "Thanks, that means a lot. Sorry I broke the TV, but you can still stay for a drink or two."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "Turn off the TV."
entries.dialogueText: Turn off the TV.
entries.menuText: Turn off the TV.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You still think I'm great? After e..."
entries.dialogueText: "You still think I'm great? After everything that's come out about me?"
entries.menuText: "You still think I'm great? After everything that's come out about me?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You still think I'm great? After l..."
entries.dialogueText: "You still think I'm great? After losing the nomination to Lileas?"
entries.menuText: "You still think I'm great? After losing the nomination to Lileas?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before kickoff, the team captain ga..."
entries.dialogueText: Before kickoff, the team captain gave a short speech endorsing Lileas Graf for president.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thanks. Let's finish the game.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks. Let's finish the game."
entries.menuText: "Thanks. Let's finish the game."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Who says I don't have fun now? Sor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Who says I don't have fun now? Sorry I broke the TV, but you can still stay for a drink or two."
entries.menuText: "Who says I don't have fun now? Sorry I broke the TV, but you can still stay for a drink or two."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thanks for that. If you don't mind..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks for that. If you don't mind, I'd rather be alone tonight after all. I want to think about my next steps."
entries.menuText: "Thanks for that. If you don't mind, I'd rather be alone tonight after all. I want to think about my next steps."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes. That's it. I'm leaving for Ky..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. That's it. I'm leaving for Kyrute tomorrow."
entries.menuText: "Yes. That's it. I'm leaving for Kyrute tomorrow."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes. That's it. I will leave for K..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. That's it. I will leave for Kyrute soon. But, first, I have to cover my tracks. Just in case."
entries.menuText: "Yes. That's it. I will leave for Kyrute soon. But, first, I have to cover my tracks. Just in case."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes, I will. But tonight's not the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I will. But tonight's not the time to start looking."
entries.menuText: "Yes, I will. But tonight's not the time to start looking."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Whoa there, cowboy!""
entries.dialogueText: "Whoa there, cowboy!"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Bummer.""
entries.dialogueText: "Bummer."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That's because I own them.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's because I own them."
entries.menuText: "That's because I own them."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I could go to Kyrute. It was the on..."
entries.dialogueText: I could go to Kyrute. It was the one completely neutral country I knew of, and a little house in the mountains wouldn't cost me much.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before kickoff, the team captain ga..."
entries.dialogueText: Before kickoff, the team captain gave a short speech endorsing me for president.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We went into the living room and se..."
entries.dialogueText: We went into the living room and settled into our chairs. The game was about to begin.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""That makes us both quitters, then...."
entries.dialogueText: "That makes us both quitters, then. Somehow, I always thought you were better than me."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm going to get back at those bas..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm going to get back at those bastards that tried to kill me."
entries.menuText: "I'm going to get back at those bastards that tried to kill me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before kickoff, the team captain ga..."
entries.dialogueText: Before kickoff, the team captain gave a short speech thanking me for all I'd done during my term.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""You're what?""
entries.dialogueText: "You're what?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm going to do everything right t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm going to do everything right this time."
entries.menuText: "I'm going to do everything right this time."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr frowned."
entries.dialogueText: Petr frowned.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr's eyes widened."
entries.dialogueText: Petr's eyes widened.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""But you're right. I should try to..."
entries.dialogueText: "But you're right. I should try to think positively."
entries.menuText: "But you're right. I should try to think positively."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Who or what else am I going to hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "Who or what else am I going to have to sacrifice before this is over?"
entries.menuText: "Who or what else am I going to have to sacrifice before this is over?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm leaving Sordland.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm leaving Sordland."
entries.menuText: "I'm leaving Sordland."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm not staying in politics after..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not staying in politics after my presidency ends."
entries.menuText: "I'm not staying in politics after my presidency ends."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm retiring from politics. My min..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm retiring from politics. My mind is made up."
entries.menuText: "I'm retiring from politics. My mind is made up."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""We'll get through this. You can co..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll get through this. You can count on me."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""And I think things are about to ge..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I think things are about to get a whole lot worse."
entries.menuText: "And I think things are about to get a whole lot worse."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Not to mention that the Court's ab..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not to mention that the Court's about to have me impeached."
entries.menuText: "Not to mention that the Court's about to have me impeached."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Right before kickoff, all of the me..."
entries.dialogueText: Right before kickoff, all of the members of FC Anrica suddenly lay down on the field.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""That sounds like the Anton I know.""
entries.dialogueText: "That sounds like the Anton I know."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""You mean...""
entries.dialogueText: "You mean..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr looked at me, his eyes glowing..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr looked at me, his eyes glowing.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""And I'm about to get crucified for..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I'm about to get crucified for giving half our country to Rumburg."
entries.menuText: "And I'm about to get crucified for giving half our country to Rumburg."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""And I think the military is still..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I think the military is still plotting against me."
entries.menuText: "And I think the military is still plotting against me."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yeah, I know.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yeah, I know."
entries.menuText: "Yeah, I know."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""In Anrica, anyway.""
entries.dialogueText: "In Anrica, anyway."
entries.menuText: "In Anrica, anyway."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yeah, I know.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yeah, I know."
entries.menuText: "Yeah, I know."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""But you're right. I've made it thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "But you're right. I've made it this far. I've got to keep going."
entries.menuText: "But you're right. I've made it this far. I've got to keep going."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I've got to face facts, Petr. It's..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've got to face facts, Petr. It's over."
entries.menuText: "I've got to face facts, Petr. It's over."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""But I've made it this far. I'll st..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I've made it this far. I'll stick out the rest of my term for you."
entries.menuText: "But I've made it this far. I'll stick out the rest of my term for you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""But sometimes being strong means k..."
entries.dialogueText: "But sometimes being strong means knowing when to throw in the towel."
entries.menuText: "But sometimes being strong means knowing when to throw in the towel."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thanks for believing in me, Petr...."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks for believing in me, Petr. I'll stick out the rest of my term for you."
entries.menuText: "Thanks for believing in me, Petr. I'll stick out the rest of my term for you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thanks for believing in me, Petr...."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks for believing in me, Petr. I'll keep going for you."
entries.menuText: "Thanks for believing in me, Petr. I'll keep going for you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before kickoff, the team captain ga..."
entries.dialogueText: Before kickoff, the team captain gave a short speech endorsing me for president.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Frozen TV dinners, my man! They're..."
entries.dialogueText: "Frozen TV dinners, my man! They're a game-changer."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr raised an eyebrow."
entries.dialogueText: Petr raised an eyebrow.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Only if you don't have anything st..."
entries.dialogueText: "Only if you don't have anything stronger."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Don't you remember? I'm sober as a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't you remember? I'm sober as a nun these days. I'm healthier than I've ever been and so, so bored."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I'm sorry you didn't learn from my..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry you didn't learn from my mistakes. She was a good woman."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What woman would want us now?""
entries.dialogueText: "What woman would want us now?"
entries.menuText: "What woman would want us now?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sure. Mothers, lock up your daught..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sure. Mothers, lock up your daughters."
entries.menuText: "Sure. Mothers, lock up your daughters."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I miss her, Petr.""
entries.dialogueText: "I miss her, Petr."
entries.menuText: "I miss her, Petr."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Just like Evelyn.""
entries.dialogueText: "Just like Evelyn."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Very convincing.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very convincing."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I miss Evelyn, too.""
entries.dialogueText: "I miss Evelyn, too."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Don't beat yourself up about it. Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't beat yourself up about it. You know she only got that far with Soll's hand up her keister."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Like I haven't done worse?""
entries.dialogueText: "Like I haven't done worse?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You still think I'm great? After g..."
entries.dialogueText: "You still think I'm great? After getting my driver killed?"
entries.menuText: "You still think I'm great? After getting my driver killed?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I wouldn't count on that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't count on that."
entries.menuText: "I wouldn't count on that."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I'm sorry about Serge, But there w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry about Serge, But there was nothing you could have done."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""So, how are things back at the off..."
entries.dialogueText: "So, how are things back at the office?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""You know what? Don't answer that...."
entries.dialogueText: "You know what? Don't answer that. You deserve one night off from politics."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Thanks for the invite, Anton. I th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks for the invite, Anton. I think we both deserve a night off from politics."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr ducked into the kitchen and to..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr ducked into the kitchen and took two beers from the fridge.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr ducked into the kitchen and he..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr ducked into the kitchen and helped himself to some orange juice from the fridge.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I just wish I could be there to he..."
entries.dialogueText: "I just wish I could be there to help you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I can't wait for our next term.""
entries.dialogueText: "I can't wait for our next term."
entries.menuText: "I can't wait for our next term."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I might never see my kids again, P..."
entries.dialogueText: "I might never see my kids again, Petr."
entries.menuText: "I might never see my kids again, Petr."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I would have followed him to the e..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would have followed him to the ends of the earth. And I basically did."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I would have followed him to the e..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would have followed him to the ends of the earth."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Excuse me, but what life? Of cours..."
entries.dialogueText: "Excuse me, but what life? Of course I'm coming with you."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Anton, this could be exactly what..."
entries.dialogueText: "Anton, this could be exactly what both of us need. A fresh start."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We're fleeing the country, not goi..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're fleeing the country, not going on holiday."
entries.menuText: "We're fleeing the country, not going on holiday."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't know. When you've messed u..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know. When you've messed up as badly as we have, there are no fresh starts."
entries.menuText: "I don't know. When you've messed up as badly as we have, there are no fresh starts."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Exactly. Some mountain air, some v..."
entries.dialogueText: "Exactly. Some mountain air, some vegetable farming, no godforsaken budget meetings ever again."
entries.menuText: "Exactly. Some mountain air, some vegetable farming, no godforskaken budget meetings ever again."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Spoilsport.""
entries.dialogueText: "Spoilsport."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Bet you'll miss Lucian, though.""
entries.dialogueText: "Bet you'll miss Lucian, though."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Very funny.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very funny."
entries.menuText: "Very funny."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I kind of will.""
entries.dialogueText: "I kind of will."
entries.menuText: "I kind of will."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Stay for a drink. Let's plan this..."
entries.dialogueText: "Stay for a drink. Let's plan this out."
entries.menuText: "Stay for a drink. Let's plan this out."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Go home and start making your arra..."
entries.dialogueText: "Go home and start making your arrangements. I'll call you in the morning."
entries.menuText: "Go home and start making your arrangements. I'll call you in the morning."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""With pleasure, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "With pleasure, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We stayed up until late, planning o..."
entries.dialogueText: We stayed up until late, planning our departure and our initial few nights of accommodation in Kyrute. By the end of it, I was excited.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Maybe Petr was right. Maybe this co..."
entries.dialogueText: Maybe Petr was right. Maybe this could be a fresh start.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""But being your right-hand man is p..."
entries.dialogueText: "But being your right-hand man is pretty much the only thing I've got left going for me."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I understand, though. I hope being..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand, though. I hope being retired means you'll actually get to have some fun."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I poured a beer for myself and a gl..."
entries.dialogueText: I poured a beer for myself and a glass of juice for Petr. We raised our cups in a brief toast.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Just wish I could be there to see..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just wish I could be there to see it through with you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I cracked open two beers and we rai..."
entries.dialogueText: I cracked open two beers and we raised the bottles in a brief toast.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I poured a beer for myself and a gl..."
entries.dialogueText: I poured a beer for myself and a glass of juice for Petr. We raised our cups in a brief toast.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I went upstairs and collapsed in my..."
entries.dialogueText: I went upstairs and collapsed in my bed.
entries.menuText: Go to bed.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't want to stay in politics.""
entries.dialogueText: "I don't want to stay in politics."
entries.menuText: "I don't want to stay in politics."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I can't wait for a fresh start in..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't wait for a fresh start in politics once my term ends."
entries.menuText: "I can't wait for a fresh start in politics once my term ends."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm not running for re-election. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not running for re-election. I'm giving up politics."
entries.menuText: "I'm not running for re-election. I'm giving up politics."
